name: Identifier
description: Stable actor URI - the value carried as an attestation's actor id, so verification can match this organization to a signer. SHOULD be non-localized-string (needs an alizarin NAPI rebuild); string for now.

name: Homepage
description: Canonical URL for the source or publisher

name: Verification Key
description: Ed25519 public key in sec:publicKeyMultibase form (z6Mk…). SHOULD be non-localized-string (the VALID_DATATYPES fix is committed; needs a NAPI rebuild), string for now. Present ONLY when the organization signs - nodegroup left blank otherwise.
